subject: pair-implementer
reason: Links, details page, Back link and signed-out redirect all work, but a missing or foreign order returns HTTP 404 with an empty body, so 'Order not found' is never shown.

items.reason: As signed-in bob, /user/orders/999999 and alice's order /user/orders/4 return HTTP 404 with a 0-byte body and no content-type, so the browser shows a blank page: no 'Order not found' text and no layout. The status code is correct, but the criterion also requires the page to show exactly 'Order not found'. See also ac5-foreign-order.png in the same folder.
items.fix: On .NET 10, setting Response.StatusCode = 404 during SSR seems to drop the rendered body, and the app has no not-found page or status-code-page handling. Make the 404 response render the page, for example by calling NavigationManager.NotFound() with a Router NotFoundPage in Routes.razor that shows 'Order not found', or another approach that keeps status 404 and renders the 'Order not found' message. Then check that the response body contains 'Order not found'.
